items: What's New, Check for Updates and Open Project open on the window you chose them from, such as Settings.
Every edit is checked for slivers, bad or frozen frames, unsynced footage and soft zooms; anything left is listed in Export with a jump to it.
The stem model is no longer inside the installer: MultiCut downloads it once, the first time you analyse a set (about 84 MB).
Learning from your drop answers keeps itself up to date; Settings shows how many answers it uses.
The same camera never jumps: back-to-back shots on one camera become one long shot, and punch-ins are gone.
